import sqlite3


def top_products(items, n):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE products (name TEXT, price REAL)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO products VALUES (?, ?)", items)
